source.note: single inverse-variance pool over every treated monitor-day in the seven fitted cities, all post-treatment days, charged days only. Cities enter by precision and day count, so this is the average treated MONITOR-DAY, not the average city <e2><80><94> read it next to t2.pooled.eqwfit.att, never instead of it. LONDON IS *NOT* WEEKDAY-RESTRICTED HERE, deliberately (2026-08-10): Tim's weekday ruling scopes to numbers reported as `the CCZ effect`, and this pool is not one <e2><80><94> its unit is the treated monitor-day across every priced system, so a ULEZ-era Saturday inside the zone IS a legitimately treated cell (the ULEZ is charging).
